title: Internal hom from a finitely presented module into a qc module is lqc-fbc and has the tensor adjoint

standard_prerequisites.name: fbc of Hom from fp modules

core_obligations: SheafHom computed in the two module categories agrees (presheaf-level construction) and is an fppf sheaf (internal-hom lemma) (proof lines 1989-1996).
lqc by the lqc-colimits lemma; fbc by check-flat-comparison-on-etale-covering (6), so SheafHom is in LQCoh^{fbc} and Q applies (proof lines 1997-2005).
Universal property: Hom(H, Q(SheafHom(F,G))) = Hom(H, SheafHom(F,G)) for qc H by the Q-adjunction, then the internal-hom-tensor adjunction lemma gives the displayed formula (proof lines 2006-2015).
proof_roadmap: Agree the two internal homs via the presheaf construction.
Place SheafHom in LQCoh^{fbc} and deduce the universal property through Q.
difficulty_reason: The agreement of the two internal homs follows from the presheaf-level construction (fppf sheaf by the internal-hom lemma); lqc from the lqc-colimits lemma; fbc from part (6) of the check-flat-comparison lemma (F of finite presentation); the universal property is the Q-adjunction composed with the internal-hom-tensor adjunction.
